name: Meeting Recap Desk
tagline: Turns meeting notes into decisions, follow-ups and named owners
description: Hand it your raw meeting notes or a transcript and it comes back with a tidy recap: what was actually decided, which follow-ups are now due, and one owner against each. The point is that nothing agreed in the room quietly evaporates afterwards. Nothing is sent anywhere without your sign-off.
author: Cypher0x9
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
